title: Catalytic ignition of the [BMIM]DCA-H2O2 propellant with the Cu(vim)2(DCA)2 complex
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,16748-16755
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00294C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yuqi Zhang, Yuan Yao, Peihao Dou, Qing Cheng, Yanqiang Zhang
The complex Cu(vim)2(DCA)2 catalyzes H2O2 to generate the reactive oxygen species ·OH, ·O2− and 1O2, which vigorously react with [BMIM]DCA IL to achieve an ignition delay time as low as 21 ms.
